prompt: In this photorealistic photo, a golden wheat field stretches under a clear sky. On the far left stands a tall woman in a blue apron holding a sharp sickle. Next to her, a small boy in striped shorts points eagerly at a large wooden cart positioned in the center. The cart is piled high with sheaves of grain and sits heavily on the dry earth. A sturdy brown horse pulls the cart, its head turned slightly toward the right where an older man in a straw hat leans against the wheel. The older man looks at the woman in the blue apron as she gestures toward the horizon. Sitting on the edge of the cart is a young girl with braided hair, her legs dangling freely. Beside her, a black cat sleeps curled up on a bundle of wheat. To the right of the cart, a farmer in denim overalls hands a canteen to a tired worker in a green shirt. The worker in the green shirt accepts the drink while wiping sweat from his forehead. Behind them, a red barn door stands open, revealing darkness inside. A white chicken pecks at the ground near the barn entrance. There is no modern machinery visible in the scene. There is no rain or cloud cover obscuring the sun.
